summary: Constructor for the selected-season UI list object (__thiscall). Calls the base UI list constructor sub_48C070 with flag 1, installs the vtable off_5A0540, sets field 0x31C to 401, inserts four linked-list entries (a UI handle at off_5BE704, then the "Normal", "TimeScaled" and "SelectedSeason" strings) via LinkedListInsertWithNodeAllocation with -1 (append), then runs SessionSetupScreenSetup on the object and returns it.
